text: Studio signed off the UI-G sketch on 2026-09-26 with the five proposed decisions, plus four amendments. A1: a cheap UsedBy.counts (asQuery/asMatched/asControl) that doesn't materialise PairRows, and every PairRow reachable from its query trial label (G3). A2: the angular frame is explicit in FixationProvenance: origin at the image/window centre, x right, y up, at a declared px/deg, carried in the type or its frame metadata, so Studio doesn't re-derive it (G2). A3: offset pages carry a cheap total before the first page is materialised, including sources.records (G2/G3). A4: cross-built codecs with stable pinned JSON for DataRecord, FixationNumber and ScanpathPosition (G1) and ReportRef (G3); Studio stores them in studio.document/studio.project. Studio's RecordNumber becomes DataRecord at the backend boundary when G1 lands.
